title: Customer Relationship Management Consultant
description:
Customer Care Transformation Consultant

**Engagement:**
 Monthly contract. Full-time on the client through diagnostics, then a delivery role as the program moves into training and monitoring.

About the role
  

OriginBluy is running a Customer Care Gold Standard program for a large utility that serves more than 23 lakh households through 60+ walk-in service centres and an inbound call centre.

The consultant is our person on the ground: they diagnose how service works today, help define the Gold Standard, and stay through training and monitoring until the client’s own managers can hold the standard.

They report to the Principal Coach and work directly with the client’s customer care leadership, centre managers and call centre teams.

What you’ll do

**Diagnose**

* Run mystery shopping at walk-in centres: brief and calibrate the shoppers, score visits and consolidate the findings
* Select and listen to recorded calls with a focus on outliers (best, worst, repeat and escalated calls) and find the root cause of each: behaviour, process, system or policy
* Interview centre managers, call centre team leads and functional heads
* Pull together existing SOPs, scripts, QA formats and MIS into one baseline

**Define**

* Map the end-to-end customer journey for the top contact reasons, both walk-in and call
* Draft the Gold Standard: interaction standards, scripts, SOPs, escalation paths and the scorecard
* Build the cost-benefit case with client Finance: contact volumes, repeat rates, cost per contact
* Run dry runs of the new standard with a pilot group and refine it

**Deliver and sustain**

* Co-deliver CSE and manager workshops with the trainer
* Administer the Ready-for-floor certification test
* Run post-training mystery shopping and call audits, produce centre-wise scores and prepare packs for leadership reviews
* Coach centre managers and TLs to observe, score and coach against the standard

What you bring

**Must have**

* **10–15 years in customer service operations**
  , including all three of the following:
* **Inbound call centre:**
   managed or ran operations or quality for an inbound voice operation, ideally 50+ seats. Hands-on with call quality monitoring, AHT, first-contact resolution, CSAT and repeat-call analysis.
* **Walk-in service centres:**
   managed a network of customer service centres or branches. Knows queue and token management, counter processes, document-heavy service requests and how to manage a multi-location network.
* **Transformation projects:**
   led at least two service transformation or process improvement projects end to end. This could be SOP standardisation, a service redesign, a contact-centre turnaround, or harmonising processes after a merger, with results you can show.
* Comfortable with data: builds analyses in Excel, works with call logs and MIS, and can turn numbers into a business case
* Can run a good interview and a good workshop. Credible with a functional head and comfortable with a frontline executive.
* **Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English**
   (spoken; written Gujarati preferred)
* Willing to travel extensively within Gujarat

**Good to have**

* Experience in utilities, city gas distribution, power distribution, telecom, banking or insurance, meaning large regulated consumer bases with high volumes of service requests
* Familiarity with regulator-defined service standards and complaint timelines (e.g., PNGRB, state electricity regulatory commission norms)
* Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above) or COPC exposure
* Experience with outsourced or agency staffing models in contact centres
* Training delivery or facilitation experience

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* A credible baseline from mystery shopping and call audits that the client’s leadership accepts
* A Gold Standard draft built from the client’s own best interactions, signed off by the client owner
* A cost-benefit case that the client’s Finance team has validated
* Strong working relationships with centre managers and call centre TLs, so that they see the program as support rather than an audit

Personal attributes

* Good at reading and getting on with people on the shop floor; earns trust quickly with frontline teams
* Rigorous with evidence: separates what they saw from what they were told
* Discreet with client data and with individual performance information
* Self-directed and able to run the program on the ground without close supervision

description:
**ABOUT US**

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing.

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.

**JOB SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to own the design, development, and verification of high-reliability firmware for our microcontroller-based satellite subsystems. In this role, you will work at the intersection of bare-metal software development and cutting-edge hardware, converting complex aerospace requirements into robust, high-performance C code.

As a key member of our engineering division, you will directly drive firmware architecture, schematic integration, and bench-level debugging. Your ownership will directly impact sub-system reliability, hardware-software integration speed, and the overall execution of our active low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite platforms.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Firmware Architecture & Design:**
  Architect, write, and debug bare-metal and low-level embedded C firmware for ARM 32-bit microcontroller systems powering satellite payloads and sub-systems.
* **Hardware-Software Integration:**
  Review hardware schematics, block diagrams, and datasheets to bring up board support packages (BSPs) and implement device drivers for analog and digital peripherals.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner closely with hardware design, thermal, and systems engineering teams to translate high-level mission requirements into optimal firmware features.
* **Hardware Bench Debugging:**
  Perform root-cause analysis, hardware bring-up, and physical debugging using DSOs (Digital Storage Oscilloscopes), logic analyzers, and multimeters.
* **Protocol & Bus Implementation:**
  Configure and optimize robust embedded communication interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS232/RS485, and USB.
* **Quality & Lifecycle Management:**
  Maintain version control, maintain code standards (e.g., MISRA C guidelines), and write technical documentation, design notes, and test cases to ensure space-grade software reliability.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **Experience:**
  4–8 years of hands-on experience in embedded C firmware development for microcontroller-based systems.
* **Education:**
  BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech / M.Sc. in Electronics Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
* **Core Programming:**
  Expert proficiency in Embedded C and bare-metal programming without reliance on abstraction layers.
* **Hardware Understanding:**
  Solid grasp of digital and analog electronics concepts, including DAC/ADC interfaces and schematic reading.
* **Lab Equipment:**
  Hands-on experience troubleshooting, testing, and debugging hardware using DSOs, multimeters, and logic analyzers.

**PREFERRED / DESIRABLE SKILLS**

* **Microcontroller Expertise:**
  Direct experience with ARM 32-bit microcontrollers, specifically Microchip SAM V71 architectures and the MPLAB IDE ecosystem.
* **Code Quality & Standards:**
  Working knowledge of MISRA C compliance and defensive programming techniques for high-reliability systems.
* **Protocols:**
  Practical exposure to industrial and aerospace protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS232/RS485, USB).

**WHY JOIN US?**

* **Pioneer Space Tech:**
  Work directly on active satellite platforms inside India's first mass-production space facility.
* **Vertically Integrated Impact:**
  See your code move rapidly from design and bench testing to integrated satellite hardware orbiting Earth.
* **Engineering Excellence:**
  Collaborate with world-class engineers across hardware, thermal, payload, and mission control domains.
* **Career Acceleration:**
  Scale your skills in a high-growth sector with continuous exposure to complex, space-grade embedded systems.
* **Competitive Package:**
  Attractive salary, comprehensive health benefits, and a culture that celebrates technical innovation and autonomy.
